text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian Defence Minister Mustafa Tlass visits Syrian forces in Lebanon and says Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu "is not a man of peace".
- French President Jacques Chirac to start a Middle East tour with a stop in Syria after mid-October.
- Syrian Information Minister Mohamed Salman tells a Yemeni media delegation that Netanyahu's policy is aimed at sabotaging the peace process and there is a united Arab position to counter it.
- Tremor hits east Mediterranean, felt in Damascus.
- President Hafez al-Assad receives a letter from Yemeni counterpart Ali Abdullah Saleh during a meeting with Yemeni Prime Minister Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani.
- The higher Syrian-Yemeni committee concludes meetings by signing a number of cooperation agreements. Both sides call for a united Arab stand to face Israeli hardline policies.
- Britain affirms the principle of land-for-peace.
- Israeli military manoeuvres in the occupied Golan Heights
